description: Measure the volume of every label in a segmentation (FreeSurfer names for SynthSeg/FreeSurfer label ids) and, optionally, of a brain mask. Writes a TSV and returns the same table inline so an agent can answer volume questions directly.

labels.description: Integer label map, e.g. SynthSeg output.

mask.description: Optional brain mask; its volume is reported as brain_mask_ml.

requirements: Python 3.10+ with nibabel and numpy; set NEUROFLOW_PYTHON to the environment
neuroflow/launch.description: python_tool.mjs checks the Python environment, then calls nf_label_volumes.run(labels, mask); volumes.tsv lands in the output dir and the returned table in $NEUROFLOW_OUTPUT_FILE.

useWhen: Answer how large each brain structure is, in mL, from a segmentation such as SynthSeg output.
Report the brain-mask volume alongside the per-label volumes.

avoidWhen.when: There is no label map yet: segment the image first.

preconditions: Python 3.10+ with nibabel and numpy; NEUROFLOW_PYTHON set to that environment.
labels is an integer label map.
effects: Writes volumes.tsv (label, name, voxels, volume_ml) to the output directory and returns the same rows plus totals inline.
Names labels with FreeSurfer names for SynthSeg/FreeSurfer label ids.

duration.basis: Measured once: 0.26 s for a SynthSeg label map of a 1 mm T1.

examples.title: Volumes from a SynthSeg label map

failures.meaning: No Python environment was found for the tool.
failures.remedy: Set NEUROFLOW_PYTHON to a Python 3.10+ environment that has the packages this tool lists.

failures.meaning: The Python environment lacks a required package.
failures.remedy: The message names the package and the fix: pip install it into that environment, or point NEUROFLOW_PYTHON at one that has it.
